run_distdepth_training: run DistDepthOptions to parse argparse CLI arguments for training a depth estimation model
run_distdepth_evaluation: run DistDepthOptions with exe eval_save to parse evaluation mode arguments for saving predictions
configure_distdepth_training: configure DistDepthOptions to set ResNet layers, dataset, batch size, and learning rate for training
configure_distdepth_cost_volume: configure DistDepthOptions to set depth binning strategy, number of depth bins, and matching frames
load_distdepth_model: load DistDepthOptions to parse arguments for loading pretrained encoder, depth, and pose model weights
